our_system.label: Our System
our_system.description: Bet when our model's win probability and Vegas's implied probability differ by more than 2%; direction is the favorite when our spread is more extreme than Vegas's, the underdog when less extreme.

vegas_favorites.label: Vegas Favorites
vegas_favorites.description: Bet the Vegas favorite in every game.

underdogs_only.label: Underdogs Only
underdogs_only.description: Bet the underdog in every game.

real_odds_coverage_note: 56/64 real completed 2026 games had a real, joined ESPN closing-line spread + moneyline (see join_espn_odds_2026.py) - only those are bet here. Coverage grows weekly as more games complete and more real odds get collected.
ats_juice_assumption: Standard -110 both sides (see betting_backtest_2026.py docstring) - ESPN's already-collected 2026 odds don't include a captured per-side spread price.
